title: Chorizo Chicken
summary: Yet another absolute banger, it is such a simple dish but contains...
extendedSummary: Yet another absolute banger - it is such a simple dish but contains really flavourful ingredients which absolutely carry. It is also a one pot dish that doesn't taste like absolute crap, so I highly recommend this. We also always serve this with a bowl of rice.

items: 1 large packet of chicken breast cut into pieces

method: Using a casserole dish, add chicken, chopped chorizo, capsicum, tomato and olives
Toss, add olives, and season with salt, pepper and olive oil
Cook for 40 mins or until chicken is cooked through
